heater_not_assigned.title: {heater} isn't assigned to the {body}
heater_not_assigned.description:
The {body} has {heater} selected as its heat source, but {heater} isn't assigned to the {body} in the IntelliCenter's heater settings, so the IntelliCenter won't heat the {body}: its pump runs and the water stays cold. Until it is assigned, Home Assistant shows no water heater for the {body}.

To fix it, assign {heater} to the {body} in the heater settings of the Pentair app or at the IntelliCenter panel. This message goes away by itself once it is.
